title: Triangle-Precise Picking Stress Test (Cityscape)
description: Stress-tests the SceneCollisionIndex BVH and triangle-precise raycaster against a procedurally generated city of thousands of buildings. The cursor is a plain HTML element layered over the canvas — it tracks the mouse and changes colour when the BVH+triangle test reports a hit, with no 3D scene mutation per frame and no GL pipeline flush.
